content.title: The Tragic Life of the First Man on the Moon
content.text: Sign in to confirm you’re not a bot This helps protect our community. Learn more How grief propelled Armstrong to the moon. Try https://brilliant.org/Newsthink/ for FREE for 30 days, and get 20% off your annual premium subscription. I highly recommend James Hansen’s biography: First Man: The Life of Neil A.
